extName.description: Extension name in Chrome and the Web Store. Max 75 characters. Keep 'Stash'.

extDescription.message: Сохраняй посты из X, импортируй все закладки, сохраняй страницы, выделенный текст и картинки в приложение Stash на Mac.

cmdScreenshot.message: Скриншот видимой части страницы в Stash

forMac.description: Popup header, after the bold word 'Stash'. Keep the leading space.

connecting.description: Popup status while it checks the app.

connection.description: Tooltip of the green or red status dot.

savePageHint.description: Popup button subtitle: what gets saved.

screenshotHint.description: Popup button subtitle: the app finds screenshots by their content.

openStash.description: Button that opens the Mac app.

openAppHint.description: Popup message when the app is closed.

alreadyUpdated.description: Confirmation when the item was saved before.

savedForLater.message: Stash не запущен — сохранено на потом
savedForLater.description: The app is closed; the save waits in a queue.

noResponse.description: Error: the extension did not answer.

reloadToReconnect.message: Перезагрузи страницу, чтобы снова подключить Stash.
reloadToReconnect.description: Error after the extension was updated.

saveToStash.description: Tooltip of the button on each X post.

savedClickRemove.message: Сохранено в Stash — нажми, чтобы удалить
savedClickRemove.description: Tooltip of the button on a saved X post.

savedPost.description: Toast after saving an X post.

importOffline.message: Stash не запущен. Открой приложение и попробуй снова.

importDoneNew.description: Bookmark import result with the number of new ones.

importTitle.description: Title of the import panel on X.

importProgress.description: Import progress, shown right after a bold number of saved bookmarks.

close.description: Accessible name of the close button.

appOffline.message: Stash не запущен. Открой приложение Stash на Mac или скачай его на stash.grasco.dev.
appOffline.description: Error when the Mac app is closed. Keep the domain.

appAnswered.description: Error with an HTTP status code.

importRedditSaved.description: Popup button: imports the user's saved posts and comments from Reddit. Keep 'Reddit'.

openPinterestBoard.description: Error when the board import starts on a page that is not a Pinterest board.

redditLoginFirst.message: Сначала войди в Reddit, затем попробуй снова.
redditLoginFirst.description: Error when the Reddit import cannot find a logged-in Reddit account.

importingCount.description: Toast that updates during a Reddit or Pinterest import. COUNT is a number.

importSavedDone.description: Toast when a Reddit or Pinterest import ends.

importStopped.description: Toast when a Reddit or Pinterest import fails. ERROR is the reason.

importBrowserBookmarks.description: Popup button: imports all bookmarks of this browser into Stash and keeps new ones in sync.

importBrowserBookmarksHint.message: Сохраняет все, а затем каждую новую
